notes.title: Prove yourself in the new PVP game mode coming to Yaoling: Mythical Journey!
notes.content: [h3][b]How to Participate[/b][/h3][p]Yaoling: Mythical Journey’s version 1.1 update brings the long awaited PVP game mode! It will be unlocked alongside the Martial Tournament at the Golden Dojo. For the Yaoling Keepers who have yet to unlock the Martial Tournament, make sure to raise your Keeper Rank to 4, and complete the mission sequence with Master Hongfu~[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/d1594de3f4bff506615a2ba71660cd093a05fa55.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Show off your team for the showdown![/b][/p][p]Keepers will be able to create and edit lineups at the Dojo by selecting Yaolings and arranging them onfield. These lineups will be uploaded for other Keepers to battle against. Make sure to dress your best as you will be leading your team![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/bff38fecdd5659554fea17bf2e5f60ba3b487453.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]While initiating “Online Duels,” Keepers can also refresh the page for new opponents, study the opponent’s lineups, and filter the number of onfield opponents. There’s also the function to search for a particular opponent or battle with your Steam friends![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/6f46d467a25519bc45f46e31709b69e0777655d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now at its lowest price since release, there’s no better time to rally your friends to see whose name will ring the loudest across the land of Yaolings![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/c25eb7e0324c015bfbd6c33cee323f292c9e2df3.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where “Toxic Armor” didn’t account for MAG scaling.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where Buzzap’s ability element didn’t align with its description.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where accessories placed on Fiary would not display.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where if a Brushira with the “Mentor” talent summons with the ability, the summon’s talent descriptions would be different from what it should be.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where Unta is able to learn ranged talents.[/p][p]Fixed the issues regarding talents for Fiary, Cutfinch, and Yuza. They can now learn ranged talents.[/p][p]Fixed the missing onfield Yaolings issue when battling against wild Brushiras.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where custom map markers could not be tracked while using controllers.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the Demon Scarlept’s weapon would turn into a leaf.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where changes to the mount hotkey were not saved after exiting the game.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the game would freeze during the quest “Dogfather.”[/p][p]Fixed an issue with Laventot's ability description.[/p][p]Fixed the description of the talent "Turret."[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Optimization:[/b][/p][p]Added a Yaoling management interface to the Player Island.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Additions:[/b][/p][p]New special items "Cat Tree" and "Concert Stage" added for the custom island.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]If the game freezes, black-screens, or is missing textures or objects, please try Verifying integrity of the game files. It can be found in the Properties->Installed Files section in the game manage tab (the gear) that can be found in the library.[/p][p]If there are other problems or comments, please leave the feedback through the link below:[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/xuLXoXxg9F94pZks9 "]https://forms.gle/xuLXoXxg9F94pZks9 [/url][/p][p]Free DLC now avaliable for download, alongside a record low discount![/p]

notes.title: 100K Copies Sold—A New Mode Unleashed! Endless Demons, Breaks All Limits!
notes.content:
For seven months, tens of thousands of Yaoling Keepers have set foot on this journey, forging bonds with Yaolings! As the village continues to thrive, the residents of this land take a moment of peace to reminisce about the past as the season of remembrance approaches: 
Roguelike gamemode is now live! Every round is a new challenge！

Qingming arrives as peace fades. Smoke rises and papers burn. Young Hongfu stands to defend the land of the Yaolings, so the battle begins! 

[h2]The brand-new “Hearth Siege” mode is now live in “Yaoling: Mythical Journey”![/h2]

 Step into the past and experience the story of the legendary Yaoling Keeper Hongfu in his youth. As darkness descends and demons emerge, lead your Yaolings into battle to protect the land anduncover the truth behind the invasion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/1854350c323f5ad5a857352e5f96885772a268fd.gif[/img]

“Hearth Siege” reimagines the core creature-collecting experience with a fresh twist—combining roguelike and auto-battle mechanics with tower-climbing and tower defense elements. 

As you defend the village, you'll capture and train Yaoling you come across, shaping your strategy through a series of unpredictable events to forge your own path to survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/9fc49a5595415fa4dd7532bddc4acb9344755c81.gif[/img]

Only through wit and strategy, by managing resources wisely and carefully planning your tactics, can you survive the relentless dangers of Hearth Siege!

“The tide of demons came unbound, yet one man, a sword in hand, held his ground!" 一An Old Rhyme 
“That old man had done some incredible things when he was young!” 一Tavern’s Boss Lady 
“Hehehe, the real reason for the demon tide is...! ! !” 一The Mastermind 
“A bonfire in the wilderness… but why? And what in the world is this ‘invisible wall’?!” 一Young Hongfu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/44d89d197967f9fafd94311661abac1a2d869fcc.png[/img]

[h2]Hearth Siege Aside! Onto the New Region! New Yaolings! New Story![/h2]
A new adventure awaits deep within the Abyss! Within the underground surrounded by towering stalactites, mysteries lie hidden—wondrous sights, unseen Yaoling, and traces of a forgotten human presence. What secrets does this uncharted land hold?

“A group of people awaited their destined savior for thousands of years, while a bone-white clock is starting its countdown…”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/a804862111d7277dbe93c10bb24d89faf5afe370.png[/img]

When the Ruler of Decay finishes its cycle, we will all become mere sacrifices—The demon lord of time and death has awoken！

Our long-lost friend “Agu” makes his return, now accompanied by a new demon lord who seems to be a… yandere?! Though, it seems like a "White Bone Spirit" reincarnate! Looks like it's time to bring out the monkey…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/2dc26e5fd271dfe38595fc43fcbdb72ab67ab930.gif[/img]

[h2]14 Species and 30 Newly Designed Yaolings, 4 Stunning New Mounts, Storage Expanded to 800! [/h2]

With abundant Spiritual Energy untouched for thousands of years, the Abyss is home to unique Yaolings unlike any seen before. With strange appearances and remarkable abilities, they stand ready to be discovered! The Spirit Shrine can also now store up to 800 Yaoling. Have you decided on your new companion yet? Time to dive together into this journey! 

New Yaolings Species: 

Spiritad (Mount), Ability: Summon two explosive tadpoles. The tadpoles will swim towards opponents and explode, dealing poison damage. Also deals additional absolute damage equal to tadpoles’ current HP. 

Fluffale (Mount), Ability: Create a Mist Shroud around the ally who took the most damage. Allies within the shroud will not be targeted by opponents. 

Barrix (Mount), Ability: Hurl the terrain forward, creating a mass of spikes. Deals piercing damage to opponents within, and applies 33 points of bleed status. 

Oomy (Mount), Ability: Fire a sticky bomb at the target, gathering nearby opponents together and immobilizing them for 2 sec. 

Inkling, Ability: Debuff the target with Inked: become weak to darkness damage. Targets that have been nearby for 3 sec also receive the same debuff for the remaining duration. Lasting 10 sec. 

Scribby, Ability: Summon a random unevolved Yaoling. 

Talox, Ability: Delve into the sky, then charge at the smallest sized opponent, dealing slashing damage. The ability has 50% lifesteal. 

Finette, Ability: Summon a downpour that moves towards opponents. Those within will receive the Wet debuff: MAG reduced, fire damage taken -20%, fire damage dealt -50%. Downpour lasts for 6 sec. 

Peckon, Ability: Transform into a high speed drill and charge at opponents with double speed, dealing piercing damage. Def increases by 80 during cast. Lasting 3 sec. 

Drymara, Ability: Sink underwater and kidnap the opponent with the fullest mana. Resurface after 7 sec and deal absolute damage to the target. 

Crystarrow, Ability: Fire a crystal bolt towards the target, dealing piercing damage and creating a crystal drop at the location. The ability's damage increases by 5% for every crystal drop on the field. 

Crystilade, Ability: Slash through targets in a direction, dealing slashing damage to opponents hit, and double against those with shields. Create a crystal drop at the location. For every crystal drop, the ability ignores 10 Def. 

Stalaknight, Ability: Create a stone aura, granting shields per sec to allies within for 6 sec. Create a crystal drop at the location. For every crystal drop, allies within the aura gain 10 extra Def. 

Ossa, Ability: Create bone cages in the surrounding area and lock all opponents within range, immobilizing them for 1 sec and dealing % Max HP piercing damage (3% against demons). Opponents hit also receive stacks of the Bonethorn debuff: When taking damage, receive piercing damage equal to the number of stacks. Bonethorn stacks willpersist throughout the battle. The ability lasts for 5 seconds, with a 3 second cooldown on every target. 

Some Charms have also been buffed： 
Rank I damage charms now start at 90 base damage. 
Cleanse, Fortify, Engrage, Invoke, Precision duration extended from 5 to 8 seconds. 
Silence and Exalt duration extended from 5 to 6 seconds. 

[h1]And thanks to all our Yaoling Keepers, we have now surpassed 100K copies sold![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/082afbdf00bbfe5db86c93e5f282771a4df7fd2b.png[/img]
















How's this for a surprise? Here's another epic update: This chair right here? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/544ae97ea8e676ff7a38baf17acd2b6cf96a1488.gif[/img]
Yes! It can finally be sat on!!! (*Currently only a portion of the chairs in the game can be sat on)

notes.title: The first major content update "Sealed Plains" is here to trailblaze 2025!
notes.content:
A missing “friend” has made her return, but alongside a dark force!
To save you, Sister Juna appeared at a critical moment, but fell into an unending nightmare…
The door to the long forgotten kingdom of the Sealed Plains has finally opened! Bring along your Yaolings and uncover its mysteries!

Whose Yaoling’s got the best drip?! The new “Yaoling Accessories” allow Keepers to decorate their Yaolings with 96 different accessories ranging from weapons, wings, headwear, and… wait, is that a rocket launcher?!

notes.title: “Yaoling: Mythical Journey” Prepare for Another Wave of Adventure!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Yaoling Keepers, It's Been A While![/h1]
Here’s a warm welcome to the winter season! Following our last update, the team has been hard at work crafting exciting new contents, and we're thrilled to announce the first major early access update “Sealed Plains” is set to release in January!

In the update, Keepers will venture into the treacherous Sealed Pains, packed with fresh and exciting gameplay experiences! The maximum rank for keepers will increase to Level 6, maximum level for Yaolings will increase to 80, and onfield Yaolings will be expanded to a maximum of 10. Additionally, player stamina will also be increased!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/f3bca56b67dcc480b4d8de8ba378c264fc1f7e72.png[/img]

[h1]New Additions to the Main Story[/h1]
After a period of peace and comfort in the village, Master Hongfu suddenly received news from the School of Prophecy. Yaoling Keeper will be embarking on a new adventure in a brand new region! However, old friends have turned into foes, while a new demon lord is rising to power...
You may even encounter a young Sister Juna on this adventure. What memory of her childhood is she keeping buried down?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/b06ccaafa4752ff3870db66c1604ff40d8e6ccae.png[/img]

[h1]New Region: A Plain of Sands[/h1]
With the new storyline comes a brand new explorable region. According to the scouts, this mysterious land once belonged to our ancestors, but is now inhabited by new and never before seen Yaolings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/db67a00eaf27fc02c5cdd3356b029ca8f1a57cd0.png[/img]

[h1]New and Unstoppable Yaolings[/h1]
In addition to the new Yaolings in the desert region, some previously unknown Yaolings have also been discovered on the Land! This update brings a total of 23 new species of Yaoling, totaling to about 56 new designs! Yamma’s "Ultra Demon Slayer: Prototype-VIII" will also make an unexpected return~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/75a8899a896ce49553f97b781a6b3b087684e0ea.png[/img]

[h1]Ride Across the Land on Brand New Mounts![/h1]
This time, not only can you seal Yaolings, but also ride them! After completing the side quest “Mountain of Ice,” Keerer’s will unlock the ability to use Yaolings as mounts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/aeb82dc6b1b5c3398e332608b8e44a3e34799981.gif[/img]

After learning the blueprints, Keepers will be able to craft saddles at Bunbun’s Cabin, unlocking the ability to ride around with your favorite Yaolings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/6d405f163d73581836c1b49787b8be900832ea26.png[/img]

[h1]Dress Your Yaolings Up With Accessories![/h1]
It’s not enough to just dress yourself up, but your favorite buddies too! Accessories for Yaolings will be introduced in the newest update, a total of 87 different items to mix a match with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/3a30564cf19cace3500b19f91f0dbed56073b20e.gif[/img]

Not only can these accessories be obtained from chests all around the world, the Yaoling Accessories shop will also be available to Keepers after finishing the side quest “Raising Temperature”! Sure you can have a powerful Yaoling, but they’ve got to look stylish too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/e97358777e8a3be2e715d893c12a98ca2143c44b.png[/img]

[h1]New Stories & New Talents[/h1]
In addition to the main story quest, many side quests featuring fun and unique characters have also been added for Keepers to find!
The “Sealed Plains” update also introduces 52 brand new talents! We’re excited to see the new combinations of talents being put to use by our talented Yaoling Keepers~
If there are any feedbacks or questions regarding the coming update, please feel free to share it in the comments! We’ll be looking forward to everyone experiencing the new adventure in the Sealed Plains. As always, thank you for your continuous support~

"Yaoling: Mythical Journey" is now available! Enjoy a 10% discount for purchases made in the two weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/b1772776e2e698a5c318f0bc51a00cba0ee8d235.png[/img]

To all our Yaoling Keepers, we have exciting news to share! After the tireless efforts of our team, the long anticipated world of Yaolings is now officially open to everyone!

The hundreds of suggestions and feedback we received during the demo, clearly conveyed the passion and expectations of our Yaoling Keepers. These feedbacks greatly helped us to optimize our early access release, and we sincerely like to thank everyone for testing out the game! We hope for everyone to continue to provide feedbacks on any bugs or issues during early access. Our team will pour all of our efforts and enthusiasm to continuously fix and optimize the game, striving to make the "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" better!

"Yaoling: Mythical Journey" will be priced at $19.99, but for the first two weeks, we are offering a 10% discount, allowing everyone to start on this journey for just $17.99!

The initial state of gameplay and experience during early access will include:
1. A main storyline that stretches about 15-20 hours, depending on playstyle and skill level.
2. Thirty explorable areas within five distinctly themed regions.
3. Around 300 different Yaolings to collect.
4. Thirteen School challenges scattered across the land, defeat them to earn their support and rewards.
5. Nine villagers to recruit, each unlocking a unique building that offers various new gameplay mechanics such as training, farming, and hatching.
6. Five powerful and striking Demon Lords awaiting your challenge.
7. Tons of hidden treasures, materials, Yaolings, and demons populating the expansive maps.
8. Dozens of outfits available for collecting and customizing.
Other than these, many more surprises are awaiting Yaolings Keepers to uncover!

In future updates, we will introduce more Yaolings, mechanics, regions, and such. We are also working to complete controller support and custom keybindings as soon as possible!
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, feel free to communicate with us and provide your feedback and suggestions so we can make improvements.
